3585.text: Welcome to the "How to  Play" Tutorial!

3587.text: Start out by using the arrow keys to move around.

3591.text: There are 5 different types of attacks you can use...

3592.text: Up+Attack = Air attack upward.Down+Attack (In Air) = Air attack downwardDown+Attack (On Ground) = Special AttackAttack (without arrow keys) = Normal AttackAttack (Using left or right arrows) = "Smash" attack (does more damage than Normal)

3593.text: Some Levels have platforms that you can go through by holding the Down Key

3594.text: You can use do Meteor Smashes on opponents in the air by knocking them downard.

3595.text: A good way to rack up damage is to use your Special attack in combination with your normal and smash attack...

3596.text: Then knock them up high or down low!

3597.text: Some fighters have projectile attacks while others use hand to hand combat techniques.

3598.text: Try all of the characters and see who you like best!

3599.text: You may also have another Human player in VS Mode...
